meta.title: Shipreel visual-language spec for app-marketing short-form video and slideshows
meta.canvas: All px values are at 1080x1920 (9:16) unless a field says otherwise. Slideshow values for TikTok photo mode are at 1080x1440 (3:4), the size TikTok stores photo-mode slides at.
meta.size_convention: size_pct_width = CSS font-size / frame width. Measured from frames by cap height (or ascender height) divided by the font's cap/ascender ratio (about 0.70 to 0.75 em), so expect about +/-5% error.

confidence_levels.measured: Measured in this study from full-resolution frames or official template PNGs.
confidence_levels.documented: Taken from official platform docs or the font's own repository, fetched 2026-10-15.
confidence_levels.convention: Widely used editing convention or caption-tool preset. Third-party sources, not platform-official.
confidence_levels.estimate: Best estimate, not verified in this study. Verify against a live screenshot before treating it as pixel-exact.

meta.method: 11 posts downloaded with yt-dlp (watch skill, frames-only because no Whisper key was configured) and measured with ffmpeg plus PIL: pixel grids on full-resolution frames, scene-cut detection (ffmpeg scene>0.3), spectral-flux audio onsets, and cut-to-transient alignment. Official TikTok and Google safe-zone template PNGs were downloaded and measured. Platform limits come from official developer docs.
caveats: The web-search budget for this session ran out partway through, so some brand colours and UI values are marked estimate.
Several 'viral' brand posts have like/view ratios of 0.15 to 0.7%, which suggests paid Spark Ad boosting. Organic posts in the set ran at 1.6 to 4.8%.
TikTok's in-app 'Classic' font changed between the 2023 and the 2025-26 frames measured here. See caption_styles[tiktok_classic_outline].notes.

caption_styles.name: TikTok Classic: white with thin black outline (the default hook-text look)
caption_styles.font: TikTok in-app 'Classic'. 2025-26 builds render a geometric sans with single-storey a and g. 2023 builds rendered a Proxima-Nova-like grotesque with a double-storey a.
caption_styles.google_font_fallback: TikTok Sans 600 (OFL, on Google Fonts; TikTok calls it 'the default font used in millions of TikTok videos'). For the 2025-26 single-storey look, Sora 600 matches the measured word-width proportions within 2%.

caption_styles.where_seen: Stronger app hook 'someone made strava but for the gym??' (82px font, 3 lines, y 323-568, 2.7M views). Stronger demo captions at 68-71px, y 275-400. Rizz app body captions at 66px (6.1%W) with a 97px (9%W) reveal title. Stronger slideshow hook at 69px on a 1080x1440 slide.

caption_styles.name: Hormozi-style word-by-word with highlighted active word (caption-tool preset)
caption_styles.font: Montserrat Black. Alternatives: Anton, Bebas Neue, TheBoldFont. Impact as last resort.
caption_styles.animation: Each word appears at its speech onset (lead by 1-2 frames). The active word gets the highlight colour and scales to at most 1.05 (instant snap). The 1-3-word group clears on the phrase boundary. Typical 200-500 ms per word. Many tools add a 100-150 ms pop (scale 0.8 to 1.0).
caption_styles.where_seen: Submagic, SendShort and CapCut 'Hormozi' presets. Spec values from ascynd.io: 80-120px, 8-12px pure black stroke, #FFD93D highlight, 1-3 words, 60-70% from top.

caption_styles.notes: Stroke must be pure #000. Near-black smears under compression (ascynd).

ui_cards.name: iMessage conversation (iOS 17/18)

specs.scale_note: Values are iOS points, then px for a full-bleed 390pt-wide phone at 1080px (x2.769). For a card at 900px wide use x2.308.
specs.sent_bubble: #0A84FF flat. The real bubble has a subtle vertical gradient of about #1E8EFF to #0A7AFF (estimate). Text #FFFFFF.
specs.font: SF Pro Text Regular 17pt = 47px, line-height 22pt = 61px. Fallback: Inter 400.
specs.bubble_radius: 18pt = 50px. The last bubble in a group gets a tail on its bottom corner.

specs.header: Centred contact avatar 50pt (138px) circle with grey initials gradient #A5ABB8 to #858994. Name 11pt (30px) with chevron. Translucent nav material about rgba(249,249,249,0.94) plus blur, hairline #D1D1D6.

In promos, reveal bubbles one at a time (pop scale 0.9 to 1.0 in 5 frames) with a soft 'pop' or swoosh per message. The Rizz app's 1.6M video used a real Snapchat chat on a handheld phone rather than a recreated card.

right_rail.note: The right inset grows to 300px between y840 and y1260 (like/comment/share rail)

tiktok.notes: Primary values are from TikTok's own In-Feed safe-zone template PNG (In-Feed-Standard Version LTR.zip, 2880x5120, labelled 720x1280 units: top 160, bottom 440, sides 80, rail 120), measured and scaled to 1080x1920. TikTok says the zone shrinks with longer captions and add-ons. Organic UI covers less, but designing to the ad template is the safe default.

reels.notes: 14% top / 35% bottom / 6% sides is Meta's Reels-ads guidance as reported by 1clickreport (Meta's page wasn't fetchable here). The right action rail sits inside the bottom 35% on Reels, so no separate rail inset is needed. Instagram's 3:4 grid crop is the centre 1080x1440 (y240-1680).

shorts.notes: Measured from Google's official vertical safe-zone overlay PNG (1080x1920). Google publishes no organic Shorts template.

universal_recommended.notes: Intersection of the TikTok, Reels and Shorts ad-safe zones. Use it for any text or UI card that must survive cross-posting. Hook text can sit at y288-560. Captions belong at y960-1248 (the lower end of the safe band, just above the bottom UI).

measured_asl_sec.stronger_ugc_hook_demo: 2 shots in 11.4 s. Hook 3.97 s, then captions swap every 2.1-2.2 s.
measured_asl_sec.rizz_pov_story: 13 cuts in 33.5 s, ASL 2.6 s, about 4 s per caption
measured_asl_sec.greg_motion_explainer: 8 hard cuts in 46.8 s (ASL 5.8 s), but animated scene changes every 1-2 s
measured_asl_sec.riley_founder_demo: 2 hard cuts in 115.5 s. Captions swap every about 1.25 s and screen content changes every 3-4 s.
measured_asl_sec.mrbeast_short: Essentially one take in 21.3 s with a graphics reveal at 10.2 s

pacing.notes: Text must be on frame 0: 10 of the 11 posts measured had hook text, a sticker or a big on-screen number on the very first frame (the exception is the text-free efewissie skit), and none opened on black. Two working length bands: under 12 s loopers (Stronger, Opal, efewissie: re-watch inflates watch time; the Stronger 'fade-in' format averaged more than 2x its 6 s length per Superwall) and 30-60 s narratives with a payoff. Founder demos can run 2 min if captions change about every 1.25 s. Plan caption changes every 1.5-2.5 s and visual changes (cut, zoom or new UI state) every 2-3 s. Montage format: 0.27-0.33 s per image on the beat grid.

motion_patterns.name: Hook text on frame 0
motion_patterns.how: Render the hook caption fully opaque from frame 0 with no entrance animation. Hold 2.3-4.0 s. Switch at the first cut.
motion_patterns.when: Every video (10 of the 11 posts measured had text or a sticker on frame 0)

motion_patterns.name: Caption swap synced to screen changes
motion_patterns.how: Replace the caption block instantly every 2.0-2.2 s, at the same frame as the cut or UI-state change. No transition.

motion_patterns.name: Punch-in zoom on jump cuts
motion_patterns.how: Scale 1.00 to 1.12 (or 1.25 for emphasis) over 4-6 frames at 30fps, ease-out cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1). Alternate 1.00/1.12 on consecutive talking-head cuts. Transform-origin on the face or on the UI element.
motion_patterns.when: Talking-head and screen-recording emphasis. Pair with a low thump SFX.

motion_patterns.name: Screen-recording zoom-and-follow (Screen Studio style)
motion_patterns.how: Zoom 1.0 to 1.8x over 18-24 frames with Remotion spring({damping:20, stiffness:100, mass:1}), origin at the click/tap point. Pan with the cursor (lerp 0.15/frame). Hold 1-2 s. Zoom out over 15-20 frames.
motion_patterns.when: Desktop or SaaS demos and vibe-coding builds. Shows prompts and results legibly on a phone.

motion_patterns.name: Handheld micro-motion
motion_patterns.how: Perlin-noise translate +/-3px and rotate +/-0.3 degrees at 0.5-1 Hz on phone mockups so they feel hand-held
motion_patterns.when: Fake-POV 'phone in hand' demos (Stronger, Rizz look)

motion_patterns.name: Impact shake
motion_patterns.how: 6-10 frames. Translate amplitude decays 12px to 0 in a random direction each frame, rotation +/-1 degree. Optional 1-frame white flash at 30% opacity.
motion_patterns.when: Beat drop, reveal of the app name or a big number

motion_patterns.name: Whip-pan transition
motion_patterns.how: 8 frames total. Outgoing translateX 0 to -100% with directional blur 60-120px. Incoming from +100% to 0 with blur decaying. ease-in-out. Whoosh SFX starts 4 frames before the cut and peaks on it.
motion_patterns.when: Scene changes in narrative edits, before/after

motion_patterns.name: Slide/push transition
motion_patterns.how: 10-12 frames, cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1). Both clips move together.

motion_patterns.name: Text pop-in
motion_patterns.how: Scale 0.85 to 1.05 to 1.0 plus opacity 0 to 1 in 6 frames (about 200 ms). Remotion spring({damping:12, stiffness:200, mass:0.6}). Exit: none (hard cut) or 3-frame fade.
motion_patterns.when: Kinetic captions, labels, stickers. Skip it for TikTok-native looks, which appear instantly.

motion_patterns.name: Word-by-word captions with active highlight
motion_patterns.how: Show each word at its transcript start minus 1-2 frames. Highlight the active word (colour plus scale 1.05) for its duration. Keep 1-3 words on screen and clear at the phrase boundary.

motion_patterns.name: Kinetic typography stagger
motion_patterns.how: Words enter 3-5 frames apart with mixed sizes, weights and italics, each with a 6-frame pop. Objects and cards slide in with soft shadows (0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.25)).

motion_patterns.name: Beat-grid photo montage
motion_patterns.how: Cut a new 3:4 photo every 8-10 frames (0.27-0.33 s) on the music's 16th-note grid. Letterbox 1080x1440 in 9:16 with 240px black bars. Static list text on top.
motion_patterns.when: Aesthetic or 'propaganda I'm falling for' list formats (Opal 954K)

motion_patterns.name: Fade-in from black looper
motion_patterns.how: 6 s clip: black fades to the image over about 1-2 s while hook text stays on. End on a frame that loops cleanly. Post micro-variants that change background, hook wording and legend placement.
motion_patterns.when: Stronger's 'viral on demand' format (Superwall: an estimated 200-300M views across hundreds of posts)

motion_patterns.name: Seamless loop
motion_patterns.how: Make the last frame match the first (or cut mid-motion that continues at frame 0). End the audio on a bar boundary. Keep the total at or under 12 s.
motion_patterns.when: Short loopers. Re-watches raise completion rate.

motion_patterns.name: Split-screen founder demo
motion_patterns.how: Top panel 1080x1260 screen or phone mockup, bottom 1080x660 webcam. Captions on the seam at y≈1290-1330. Optional header box for the first 3 s.

motion_patterns.name: Reply-to-comment opener
motion_patterns.how: Show the TikTok reply sticker top-left (x89, y358) from frame 0 for 3-3.6 s, then cut to the answer, using a proof screenshot or demo as B-roll.
motion_patterns.when: Objection handling and FAQ content (Cal AI)

motion_patterns.name: UGC reaction hook, then product demo
motion_patterns.how: 0-4 s: a person reacting to camera with the hook text. Hard cut on the music swell to a hand-held phone demo with 3 feature captions at about 2.1 s each.
motion_patterns.when: Highest-scale app-ad format observed (Stronger 2.7M and 851K variants)

motion_patterns.name: Number count-up
motion_patterns.how: Animate from 0 (or the previous value) to the target over 24-30 frames with an ease-out-expo, tabular numerals. Ticks during, cha-ching on land.

sfx_conventions.sfx: Whoosh (250-400 ms) peaking on the cut frame
sfx_conventions.notes: Measured: Greg Isenberg Short cuts at 4.42 s and 15.21 s coincide with 7.2x and 7.7x spectral-flux spikes. 38% of its cuts carry a transient against a 15% random baseline.

sfx_conventions.sfx: Cut on the music swell or drop
sfx_conventions.notes: Measured: Stronger's strongest audio transient (3.82 s) sits 0.15 s before the only cut (3.97 s)

sfx_conventions.sfx: Riser 1-2 s, then impact/boom or a bright 'ding' at the reveal
sfx_conventions.notes: Measured: MrBeast 'WINNERS' reveal preceded by a 7.2x transient at 10.0 s. Rizz's 10.4x transient at 4.36 s leads into 'No worries I got the solution'.

sfx_conventions.sfx: Soft pop or click, 20-60 ms, about 12-18 dB under the voice-over
sfx_conventions.notes: One per caption block, not per word, in speech-led videos (convention)

sfx_conventions.sfx: Key clicks per character, randomised pitch +/-5%

sfx_conventions.notes: Use generic sounds. Don't use Apple's or Stripe's own sounds.

sfx_conventions.sfx: Ticks during the count, then 'cha-ching' or coins on landing
Vine boom, record scratch or buzzer

sfx_conventions.notes: Measured mean RMS: music-only Stronger -11.7 dBFS, speech-led videos -18 to -26 dBFS. Duck music 6-10 dB under speech. Master to about -14 LUFS integrated, -1 dBTP. No silent gaps over 0.5 s in any music-led video measured.

sfx_conventions.sfx: None; cuts ride the music grid
sfx_conventions.notes: Measured: Opal cuts every 0.27-0.33 s against a 1.37 s beat period, so no per-cut SFX

tiktok.image_size: 1080x1440 (3:4) is what the 6.9M-view Stronger slideshow stores. 1080x1920 fills the screen. TikTok letterboxes 3:4 in the feed.
tiktok.format: JPEG or WebP, max 1080p, at most 20 MB each (Content Posting API)
tiktok.music: Required in practice. Trending sound added in-app (Larry workflow) or original sound (Stronger, 56 s track). API auto_add_music is optional.

instagram.image_size: 1080x1350 (4:5) default for carousels. 1080x1440 (3:4) matches the 3:4 profile grid Instagram introduced in 2025 (not re-verified here). API accepts aspect 4:5 to 1.91:1, width 320-1440.
instagram.notes: The first slide is the hook and the last slide a 'save/share/follow' or app CTA. Text should stay inside the centre 1080x1350 if you author at 3:4.

text_style.font: TikTok Classic look: TikTok Sans 600 / Sora 600
text_style.size: 69px on a 1080-wide slide (6.4% W). 1-2 short lines separated by a blank line. 5-12 words.
text_style.color: #FFFFFF with a thin #000000 outline (about 3-4px) and soft shadow
text_style.placement: Centred horizontally, block centre at 41-52% of slide height (measured y590-744 of 1440). Never in the top 240px (status bar and tabs) or the bottom 660px of a 9:16 frame. Larry's failed posts had text 'too small' and 'positioned too high, hidden behind TikTok's status bar'.
text_style.background_photo: Dark, candid, phone-camera-real photo (moody gym, room, desk). Real-looking beats polished.

slideshow_specs.recipe: 6 slides. (1) HOOK: real-looking photo plus a 1-2-line identity or question hook ('am I strong? male 75kg edition'), or the Larry formula '[another person] + [doubt] -> showed them [the app/AI] -> they changed their mind'. (2-5) VALUE: one idea per slide, at most 20 words. Repackage the app's own output as standalone content (tables, rankings, before/after, generated images) under a small app wordmark and a consistent template, so viewers swipe for the next data point. (6) CTA: app name in a brand pill, social proof (users and rating laurels), store badges, phone mockup with the result screen. Caption: story-style mention of the app ('got these from the stronger app...') plus 3-5 hashtags. Add a trending sound. Post 1-3 a day and test hooks; the same template gets reused with new hooks.

cover_patterns.name: Hook-on-frame-0 default cover
cover_patterns.how: TikTok defaults the cover to the first frame (video_cover_timestamp_ms unset), so a fully legible hook on frame 0 doubles as the cover. Keep it inside the centre 1080x1440 band (y240-1680) because profile grids crop to about 3:4.

cover_patterns.name: Series template cover
cover_patterns.how: Same position, font and colour box on every cover ('Day 14 building my app', 'App #3 that makes $1k/mo'): 3-6 words at 8-10% W in a TikTok black/white box, centred at about 45% H, so the profile grid reads as a series.

cover_patterns.name: Result-first number
cover_patterns.how: Big revenue or user number (e.g., '$4,218 MRR', '1M users') at 12-15% W plus a small context line. Uses the counter_rollup end frame.

cover_patterns.name: Before/after split
cover_patterns.how: Horizontal split at 50% H with BEFORE/AFTER labels at about 6% W, showing the app transformation result (room, physique, photo)

cover_patterns.name: Reply-sticker cover
cover_patterns.how: Keep the 'Reply to @user's comment' sticker visible in the cover frame. It signals a continuation and answers an objection.

cover_patterns.name: Photo-mode cover
cover_patterns.how: photo_cover_index = 0 (the hook slide). Hook text must be readable at grid-thumbnail size, so at least 6% W.

cover_patterns.name: Shorts thumbnail
cover_patterns.how: Pick a frame in the YouTube mobile app (no API equivalent documented here). The Shorts shelf shows 9:16. Use a face with emotion plus 3-5 words centred, avoiding the bottom 672px and the right 192px.

cover_patterns.name: Reels cover
cover_patterns.how: Upload a 9:16 JPEG (at most 8 MB). The grid crops to the centre 3:4 (y240-1680), so keep the title there.

tiktok.resolution: 1080x1920 recommended. API min 360px and max 4096px per side. Ads at least 540x960.
tiktok.codec: H.264 (recommended), H.265, VP8, VP9. Containers MP4 (recommended), WebM, MOV.
tiktok.bitrate: No upload maximum documented. Ads at least 516 kbps. Delivered copies measured here: HEVC 0.42-1.6 Mbps at 1080x1920/30fps, so upload at 15-25 Mbps H.264 High to survive the re-encode.
tiktok.max_length: 10 min via API (3, 5 or 10 min depending on the creator). Ads up to 10 min.
tiktok.caption_limit: 2,200 UTF-16 runes for video via the Direct Post API. 4,000 for photo-post descriptions (API). Photo title 90.
tiktok.hashtags: No documented cap (they count toward the caption). Norm: 3-5 niche plus product tags (Stronger slideshow used 3; Larry at most 5).
tiktok.photo_mode: Up to 35 images, JPEG/WebP, at most 20 MB each, max 1080p

reels.codec: H.264 or HEVC, progressive, closed GOP, 4:2:0. MOV/MP4 with moov atom at the front, no edit lists. Audio AAC at most 48 kHz, 1-2 channels, 128 kbps.
reels.max_length: 3 s to 15 min (API). In-app recording limits differ.
reels.carousel: Up to 10 via API (20 in-app). Images JPEG at most 8 MB, 4:5 to 1.91:1, width 320-1440.

shorts.codec: MP4 (fast-start). H.264 High Profile, CABAC, progressive, 2 B-frames, closed GOP of half the frame rate, 4:2:0. Audio AAC-LC or Opus at 48 kHz, stereo 384 kbps.
shorts.bitrate: 1080p SDR: 8 Mbps (24-30 fps) or 12 Mbps (48-60 fps)
shorts.max_file_size: No Shorts-specific cap documented (YouTube general upload cap applies)
shorts.caption_limit: Title 100 chars, description 5,000 chars (YouTube limits, not re-fetched)
shorts.hashtags: Up to 3 shown above the title. More than 60 means all are ignored.
shorts.music: Shorts audio library tracks usable for up to 90 s (some 60/30 s). Claimed Shorts over 1 min are blocked globally.

x.resolution: API doc: 32x32 to 1280x1024. Recommended portrait 720x1280 (1080x1920 uploads are common in-app).
x.codec: H.264 High Profile, progressive, no open GOP, YUV 4:2:0, square pixels. Audio AAC-LC mono or stereo (no HE-AAC).
x.bitrate: At least 5,000 kbps video and 128 kbps audio recommended
x.max_length: 0.5 s to 20 min (default). 125 min for Premium/verified (API).
x.media_per_post: Up to 4 photos, or 1 GIF, or 1 video. Images JPG/PNG/GIF/WEBP at most 5 MB.

linkedin.codec: MP4, MOV, WEBM, MKV, AVI and others (H.264 MP4 safest)

threads.codec: H.264 or HEVC, MOV/MP4 (moov front). Audio AAC at most 48 kHz, 128 kbps.
threads.hashtags: One topic tag per post (not re-fetched)
threads.images: JPEG/PNG at most 8 MB, width 320-1440, aspect up to 10:1. Carousels 2-20 items.

bluesky.codec: video/mp4, video/mpeg, video/webm, video/quicktime, image/gif accepted by the app (H.264 MP4 safest)
bluesky.hashtags: Supported as facets, no documented cap. Norm 1-3.
bluesky.images: Up to 4 per post. The app compresses to at most 2,000,000 bytes and 4000 px max dimension.

facebook_reels.codec: H.264 or H.265 (VP9 and AV1 also accepted). Progressive, 4:2:0, closed GOP 2-5 s. Audio AAC-LC 48 kHz stereo at least 128 kbps.
facebook_reels.max_length: 3-90 s via the Reels Publishing API. In-app limits may be longer (not verified).
facebook_reels.caption_limit: Not documented for Reels (description supports hashtags)
